projects.projectDescription: A Vikings TV series fan blog I built and ran between ages 12 and 14: consistent publishing, SEO with Yoast on WordPress, Google Analytics, Patreon, and a global audience — lessons in community, grit, and solo execution before AI tooling existed.

Personal site and digital CV with a built-in AI demo: ask questions in chat or use live voice, with answers grounded in documents about me. Built with Vue and Spring Boot on PostgreSQL; still evolving following my bachelor's thesis (2026).

A fully deployed website that provides a platform to improve crisis preparedness in Norway. This project was developed as part of an agile development course, focusing on real-world application of software engineering principles.
projects.courseName: IDATT2106 System Development 2 with Agile Project

projects.projectDescription: As part of the Statistical Learning and Data Science course at NTNU, I conducted a LEGO-themed data analysis project applying regression, classification, and clustering methods to extract insights from a real-world dataset. This project demonstrates practical application of machine learning techniques on real data.
projects.courseName: ISTx1003 Statistical Learning and Data Science

projects.projectDescription: This project implements a solution to the shortest-path problem using map data from the Nordic countries. The program utilizes both the Dijkstra algorithm and the ALT search algorithm to compare performance and accuracy. In addition, the program offers functionality to locate the nearest points of interest (POI).
